mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (place_id, user_id, rating, content, visit_date) VALUES (#{placeId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{visitDate})
mapper.select: SELECT id, place_id AS placeId, user_id AS userId, rating, content, visit_date AS visitDate, created_at FROM reviews WHERE place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
